note: Append-only log of human/agent corrections to a mutating lane's output. One entry per correction, newest last. THE RULE (QUALITY.md §3): any PR that corrects what a lane wrote — or corrects the read-back that was used to verify it — appends its entry HERE, in that same PR. scripts/check-lane-autonomy.ts resets a lane's intervention-free week count to the latest entry for that lane, so an unlogged correction silently buys autonomy the lane did not earn. Every `source` below was verified with `gh pr view` before it was written down; nothing here is inferred.

interventions.what: The lane's writes were correct, its read-back was not: STRONG_BASES still listed only three tiers, so the 58 rows this lane awarded `product-integration` were counted as weak and the board read the completed work as failed.
interventions.source: PR #1297 — fix(quality): the strong-basis metric ignored two new evidence tiers (merged 2026-09-04T16:24Z); written up as Lesson 1 in QUALITY.md by PR #1310

interventions.what: Same defect, same PR: the 115 rows this lane awarded `repo-activity` were excluded from the strong-basis metric, so weakLiveRows read 790 when it was 617.
interventions.source: PR #1297 — fix(quality): the strong-basis metric ignored two new evidence tiers (merged 2026-09-04T16:24Z); written up as Lesson 1 in QUALITY.md by PR #1310

interventions.what: 34 registry assets were served as `live` with exactly one holder — the issuer or its custodian — against the spec's own "live = issued with supply and activity"; a second auditor found it and a new `issued-single-holder` state now says so, plus six double-deployed tranches linked via `pairedWith`.
interventions.source: PR #1302 — fix(rwa): registry corrected after a cross-vendor audit (merged 2026-09-05T00:15Z)

interventions.what: The sls-023 close-out on issue #494 was overclaimed — 11 of the finding's 61 rows were treated as closing the whole probe. Recorded as a violated lesson ("verify before advertise (#494, twice)"); the close-out itself has not yet been reframed upstream, so this stays open as a correction against the lane that now owns those rows.
interventions.source: PR #1310 — quality: program audit wrap (merged 2026-09-05T04:04Z), QUALITY.md Lessons 2026-09-05

interventions.what: The nightly step was gated to workflow_dispatch, so the 3 scheduled runs since the cron was added on 2026-09-02 executed nothing (18 completed runs in total, most manual dispatches; corrected 2026-09-05 from the runs' job steps); the gate was removed so schedule runs write. Found by the lane-autonomy counter's first run.
interventions.source: PR night/notes-nightly (this fix); runs 33851502654 and 33731681303 show the step skipped

interventions.what: Its 11 Draft hides were overwritten 30 minutes later by curate-projects' DUPE_MERGES step, which forces status=Inactive on every shadow (scripts/data/curate-projects.ts, 'if (dupe.status !== "Inactive")'). Two lanes own one field with different verdicts; the July fold (Inactive + canonicalSlug) won silently. Rows stay hidden from search and the board either way; the wrong status on duplicates is the open class in improvements/drafts/2026-09-05-inactive-site-liveness-triage.md.

Verification-packet verdict orbitcdp Inactive→Live (tier: high) was wrong and was executed (#1345, run 33979942527): the packet accepted the page's 'Live on Stellar' banner as a live signal while the protocol stats on the same page are empty dashes. Owner corrected to Inactive. Rule that follows: a marketing banner is never a product-state signal; a Live verdict needs the product itself (stats, app, chain activity) to be alive.
interventions.source: #1345 corrected by the owner in chat; receipt improvements/receipts/orbitcdp-2026-09-05.json

interventions.what: Verification-packet verdict skyhitz Live (tier: high) was wrong and was executed (#1345): the page's stats are zero (Total Mass 0.00 HITZ, Balance —). Owner corrected to Inactive. Same class as orbitcdp: a page title plus a repo push is not a product state.
interventions.source: #1345 corrected by the owner in chat; receipt improvements/receipts/skyhitz-2026-09-05.json

interventions.what: Eight high-tier packet stamps (fairblock, untangled, wagelink, hot-wallet, tala, normal, vanna-finance, zebec) rested on evidence the packet's own table calls thin (8–40 rendered chars; a hackathon, seeder, shared or 404-substitute repo as the second signal). Withdrawn to site-liveness the same evening after a cross-vendor audit; status unchanged. Rule tightened: Live = product state, own repo, substantive page.
